reviews.body: The dal base in the blend gives it body which most packaged sambar masalas miss. I still add a little extra curry leaf but the base is right.

reviews.title: Cardamom pods are fat and green
reviews.body: You can judge elaichi by the colour and these are proper green, not the faded ones you get in loose stock. The pods are big too.

reviews.title: Wholesale order for our mess
reviews.body: We order 25 kg a month for a hostel mess. Pricing was fair, GST invoice came immediately and the quality has not drifted. Good supplier.

reviews.title: Jeera actually crackles
reviews.body: You can tell the oil content is high because it pops the second it hits the ghee. Small thing but it is the difference between good and ordinary.

reviews.title: Very good, lid could be tighter
reviews.body: No complaints about the spice itself — the mirchi has a clean heat and colours the oil properly. Only thing is the lid does not click shut as firmly as I would like. Still reordering.

reviews.title: Good spice, price is on the higher side
reviews.body: Quality is not in question, the coriander is clearly fresh-ground. But at this price I would like a slightly larger pack size option.

reviews.title: Good but I wanted whole coriander
reviews.body: Ordered expecting whole seeds and got powder. My mistake reading the listing, and the powder is fine quality. Just flagging for others.

reviews.title: Delivery was quick, packing was solid
reviews.body: Ordered on a Tuesday, had it Thursday. Everything was bubble-wrapped individually and not one jar had shifted. Appreciated that.

reviews.title: Garam masala is properly aromatic
reviews.body: You can smell the cardamom and clove the moment the lid comes off. Clearly roasted before grinding. This is not supermarket stuff.

reviews.title: Combo is genuinely good value
reviews.body: Did the maths before ordering — the six-jar combo works out cheaper than buying the same weights separately, and the jars are properly sealed. Will reorder.

reviews.title: Bought for my mother, she wants more
reviews.body: Gifted the signature collection and got a phone call the same evening. She says the jeera is noticeably heavier and more fragrant than what she buys locally.

reviews.title: Running two cloud kitchens on this
reviews.body: Consistency is the whole game for us and the garam masala has been identical batch to batch across three orders. That alone is worth the price.

reviews.title: Ordered three times now
reviews.body: Started with the golden trio to test, now I buy the six-jar combo. Nothing has disappointed yet and the reorder process is quick.

reviews.title: Chana masala makes proper chole
reviews.body: The amchur and anardana combination gives that sour note you only get at stalls. Took my chole up a level honestly.

reviews.title: Delivered all the way up here, no issues
reviews.body: Was worried about transit to a remote pin code but it arrived in four days, sealed and intact. Very happy.

reviews.title: Star anise is intact and whole
reviews.body: Whole stars, none broken, strong liquorice smell. I use one per pot of biryani and it is plenty.

reviews.title: Great gifting option
reviews.body: Sent the signature collection to my in-laws for Diwali. The box looked presentable enough to hand over without rewrapping.
